deploy-bot: Finished rollout v2026.03.22-rc3 to prod-usw2. Canary->full. Triggered post-deploy checks: synth-heartbeat, kv-prefill, latency-smoke. Run details: https://deploy.redwood/run/4319998888
jamie: saw deploy-bot. launching quick smoke checklist now. @sana can you own kv-prefill check?
sana: on it. I'll run the prefill queries and watch p95 for 5m.
mike: I've got infra dashboards open — nodes healthy, no OOMs. watching CPU on g4-2 spike around 02:12UTC.
olivia: synth-heartbeat shows a 0.6% 5xx blip at 02:14, looks concentrated around eu routing. replaying the synth trace now.
tara: product sanity check — did a 20-user smoke against the new route, outputs look fine overall. saw minor tokenization diff for 1/20, not blocking.
sana: kv-prefill p95 stable ~80ms -> within target; no evictions. command I ran: `curl -sS https://smoke.prod/usw2/kv-prefill | jq .latency.p95`
olivia: replay result: the 5xx spike aligns with eu1->usw2 cross-region fallback at 02:13-02:15. deploybot shows fallback policy triggered. seems like a transient connection flakiness, not a model regression.
jamie: decision time — pin and rollforward or hold and rollback? @mike any infra signal that suggests rollback?
mike: infra perspective: no node reboots, no memory pressure. saw a transient net blip at 02:13 in eu1, resolved by 02:16. not systemic. recommend rollforward + close monitoring. :thumbsup: 
olivia: agree with mike. I'll add a synthetic watch to escalate if 5xx > 0.5% over any 5m window in next 30m, and raise a pin if it persists.
tara: ok to proceed from product. I'll file follow-up ticket INFR-278 for tokenization noise and link sample traces.
jamie: rollforward approved. pinning v2026.03.22-rc3 for 60m with auto-unpin if stable. @deploy-bot please annotate release notes and close this smoke thread.
